edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC5 Exception X1 (legacy RWB-E3-010 guard path)
    Given a role without the right in capability area Treatment and offer
    When the role reads the booked schedule
    Then the request is refused with 403 before any read of the treatment
    Then the user sees MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC6 Exception X3 (stale ACE batch)
    Given the ACE data behind v_ace_plan or v_ace_payment is older than the freshness rule VR-S2-010-1
    Given a case in state WITH_OPS_BOOKING
    When booking confirmed
    Then the confirmation is refused and the case stays in WITH_OPS_BOOKING
    Then the user sees MSG-P1-001 naming the date

  Scenario: AC7 Exception X4 (NLEADS or ALS not acknowledged)
    Given a case in state WITH_OPS_BOOKING
    Given ALS or NLEADS has not both acknowledged
    When booking confirmed
    Then R-RES-22 does not fire and the case stays in WITH_OPS_BOOKING
    Then the booking stays with operations

  Scenario: AC8 Exception X5 (first_due_date absent)
    Given a case in state BOOKED_IN_ALS_NLEADS
    Given first_due_date is absent from the plan facts
    When schedule set
    Then R-RES-25 does not fire and the case stays in BOOKED_IN_ALS_NLEADS
    Then no clock starts

  Scenario: AC9 Exception X6 (booking facts disagree)
    Given a case in state WITH_OPS_BOOKING
    Given the booking facts disagree with the agreed terms
    When booking confirmed
    Then booking_difference records the difference
    Then the booking is held in WITH_OPS_BOOKING for operations

  Scenario: AC10 Exception X7 (EV-11 redelivered or duplicated)
    Given EV-11 TreatmentBooked is redelivered or two events for one booking arrive
    When the inbox receives them
    Then the inbox dedupes by cloud event id
    Then one schedule, one decision record and one timer set exist

  Scenario: AC11 Exception X8 (field refused by the library)
    Given the record library refuses a field
    When the action is taken
    Then nothing changes and the case stays where it was
    Then the field is named with MSG-P7-009
